method: Sequential procedural mesh construction in Blender from manufacturer silhouettes; preserve existing model except explicitly replaced incomplete cast envelopes. No generated image used as evidence.
coordinates: glTF metres: X left, Y up, Z forwards; Blender conversion (x,-z,y).
estimated_parts: closed central crankcase between original side covers
lower airbox/battery enclosure, outer envelope only
front engine mounting plates and fasteners
ignition coil body and HT lead to existing plug cap
fuel hose from existing tap to carburettor
under-tank wiring loom and visible clips
throttle cable connecting existing grip guide to carb entry
dimension_policy: All new dimensions estimated from existing mating envelopes and manufacturer views. Typical uncertainty 10-20 mm for shells and 20-40 mm for hidden routes; fastener diameters illustrative. No exact engine internals claimed.
keep: tank, frame, wheels, original main engine side covers, finned cylinder/head, intake assembly, controls, previous clamp correction
review: actual Babylon glTF load, texture readiness and validation
